documents.text: 2013 China Open (snooker) The 2013 Bank of Beijing China Open was a professional ranking snooker tournament that took place between 25 and 31 March 2013 at the Beijing University Students' Gymnasium in Beijing, China. It was the tenth ranking event of the 2012/2013 season. Peter Ebdon was the defending champion, but he lost 3–5 against Marcus Campbell in the last 32.
